component.name: Floe
component.summary: Install and update flatpaks from GitHub releases

description.p: Floe keeps a list of GitHub repositories that attach a .flatpak bundle to their releases, checks them for new versions and installs updates, without publishing anything to Flathub. It uses the GitHub CLI, so private repositories work with your existing login.

ul.li: Add repositories by owner/name or link, with an optional asset pattern and pre-releases
Check one or all repositories, on launch and on a schedule
Install or update with one click, or update everything at once
Release notes, activity log and desktop notifications

description.p: The Add repository form shows a generic example (owner/app-name) instead of a specific repository.
Floe can update itself: Settings → Floe updates checks its own GitHub releases, installs the new version with a live console, and restarts.

Live console output for downloads and installs, with a Cancel button and a download progress bar. Apps that are already installed are found and linked when you add their repository, and a new Installed page lists the flatpaks on this computer.
